details:
One of my users has reported that their avatar fails to load.

It turns out that one of their expression parameters was called "[Add-On]" (more precisely, it had the substring "[Add-On]" in the parameter name).

This expression parameter name will cause OSCCore to internally crash, because it is being interpreted as an invalid regex.

How to reproduce:

- Create an expression parameter called:

[Add-On]

- Upload the avatar

- Load into the avatar in-game (probably OSC is needed?)

Observed:

- The avatar fails to load

- The expression menu is grayed out

- The avatar does not show up in mirrors

- The VRChat output logs has the following:
